_comment: EyPipes Mod Configuration File - Edit these values to customize the mod behavior

crop_settings._growth_chance_description: Probability of crop growing each random tick (0.0-1.0)
crop_settings._max_age_description: Maximum age the crop can reach before being harvestable
crop_settings._grow_upper_age_description: Age at which the crop starts growing the upper part
crop_settings._requires_support_description: Whether the crop needs a solid block below to grow

drying_rack_settings._comment: Settings for the Erbapipa Drying Rack
drying_rack_settings._requires_sunlight_description: Whether drying requires direct sunlight access

loot_settings._comment: Settings for crop drops and loot tables
loot_settings._erbapipa_drop_rolls_description: Base rolls for erbapipa/seeds drop pool (0.0-1.0)
loot_settings._seeds_bonus_rolls_description: Additional rolls for bonus seeds when crop is mature (0.0-1.0)
loot_settings._seeds_fortune_probability_description: Probability modifier for Fortune enchantment on seed drops (0.0-1.0)
loot_settings._fortune_description: Whether Fortune enchantment affects drop rates
loot_settings._erbapipa_drop_percentage_description: Percentage chance to drop erbapipa when crop is mature (0.0-100.0)
loot_settings._seeds_drop_percentage_description: Percentage chance to drop seeds when harvesting (0.0-100.0)

recipe_settings._comment: Settings for crafting and processing recipes
recipe_settings._cutting_output_description: Number of cut erbapipa produced when cutting dried erbapipa
recipe_settings._knife_tag_description: Whether to use conventional knife tags for cutting recipes

compost_settings._seeds_compost_description: Chance for erbapipa seeds to increase compost level (0.0-1.0)
compost_settings._erbapipa_compost_description: Chance for erbapipa to increase compost level (0.0-1.0)

gameplay_settings._tall_crop_description: Whether erbapipa grows as a tall crop (2 blocks high)
gameplay_settings._breaking_behavior_description: Whether breaking the upper part also breaks the lower part
gameplay_settings._fertilizer_description: Multiplier for bone meal and other fertilizer effectiveness (1.0 = normal)

performance_settings._tick_rate_description: Multiplier for how often the mod processes ticks (1.0 = normal)
performance_settings._max_racks_description: Maximum number of drying racks allowed per chunk (0 = unlimited)

integration_settings._farmers_delight_description: Whether to enable Farmer's Delight integration features
integration_settings._jei_description: Whether to show recipes in JEI (Just Enough Items)

debug_settings._debug_logging_description: Whether to enable detailed debug logging
debug_settings._growth_particles_description: Whether to show particles when crops grow
